abstract.t: GEVP defines minimal protocol for epistemic convergence. Renamed from VCP to avoid collision with draft-kamimura-scitt-vcp. Invariant C_manip > C_val*2.0 as engineering heuristic. Theta 0.73 RECOMMENDED pinned 7755f53. Architecture stable per https://github.com/GravitOpenNetwork/gravit-canon.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: Gravit open network for verifiable knowledge transformations. Stable. Future is implementations.
GEVP defines ESM RAW->VALIDATED->VERIFIED->COMMITTED, verification types, persistence MAY Ledger IPFS GSS DB Archive, bindings separate.

section.name: Conventions
section.t: The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "REQUIRED", "SHALL", "SHALL NOT", "SHOULD", "SHOULD NOT", "RECOMMENDED", "NOT RECOMMENDED", "MAY", and "OPTIONAL" in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 when, and only when, they appear in all capitals, as shown here.

section.name: Epistemic State Machine
section.t: States RAW VALIDATED VERIFIED COMMITTED explicit logged.

section.name: Protocol Data Types
section.t: Artifact id hash SHA3-256 claim provenance signatures optional. Record artifact-id verifier-id theta 0.73 result timestamp. Convergence h>0.7 f<0.3.

section.name: Persistence
section.t: MAY not MUST. Ledger IPFS GSS DB Archive.

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: Replay hash nonce. Sybil cost model. No PII. Signatures OPTIONAL.

section.name: Privacy Considerations
section.t: Content MAY encrypted, provenance MAY redacted.

section.name: Implementation Status
section.t: MVR 0.1.0-mvr https://github.com/GravitOpenNetwork/gravit-canon SHA 7755f53 TPR 93.4 FPR 0.4 theta 0.73 RECOMMENDED.
